hook.name: PhiEthHooks
hook.description: A custom-curve hook implementing 1:1 ETH↔phiEth swaps. In beforeSwap, it takes input from the PoolManager, calls phiEth.deposit() or phiEth.withdraw() to convert, settles output, and returns a BeforeSwapDelta to bypass concentrated liquidity entirely. Liquidity additions are blocked, and the hook only initializes ETH/phiEth pools with zero fee.
